Indian Companies Report Mixed Financial Results for Q1

Several Indian companies have released their first-quarter financial results, showing varied performance across sectors. While some firms, like Hindustan Zinc and SAIL, reported significant jumps in net profit, others experienced declines or modest growth. These results provide insights into the current economic landscape and corporate health.
